simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עָנָק (H6060) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עָנָק (ʻânâq) means a necklace (as if strangling ) First listed occurrence: Judg 8 26.

definitions.full: H6060. anaq II. עֲנָק noun masculine Song of Solomon 4:9 necklace, neck-pendant (Aramaism according to Lag BN 175 ); — absolute ׳ע Song 4:9 apparently part of necklace, perhaps neck-pendant ; plural עֲנָקוֺת Judg 8:26 (ornament of camels), עֲנָקִים Prov 1:9 (of youth; in figure).
